It can also loop forever on cycles. The core bug is introduced at line 11 where the unchecked parent is assigned to `j`.</thought> The check at line 6 only validates the initial `j`; when the while loop follows a differential link, the new parent index is never bounds-checked before being used to index `is_differential`, `default_table`, and `accept`, allowing out-of-bounds reads (and infinite loops on cycles). The unchecked assignment happens at line 11.

Answer: 11
